item.title: Combiner 0.13.0
item.description:
• A simpler room. Each person's lane now reads like their DAW's track list: their song, its tracks in the DAW's order and colours, and each track's prints folded inside it (the newest WET, ORIGINAL, MIDI and synth patch; older renders behind a fold). Click LATEST beside Search to see everything in the order it arrived, under Today, Yesterday and Earlier.
  • Less text on every row: a name, a picture and a few icons. An hourglass means a synth patch changed since the last render, a crossed-out speaker a muted track, a bin a deleted one. Rest the pointer on a row for 2 seconds for the details: the song, your friend's DAW, when it was made, how long, the plug-ins.
  • Synth patches show their synth's icon: Serum, Phase Plant, Vital, Surge XT and Pigments by their makers' icons, anything else by a plain glyph.
  • The arrow keys move through the list. Space plays, → and ← open and close a track, Tab goes to the next person, Esc stops. While something plays, moving to another row plays that one.
  • ⚙︎ › View has the old list back (Classic list), more words on hover (Detailed), rows in each person's colour, and plain synth glyphs, if you prefer them.
  • The Cold Steel look is clean by default: no scratches, flat blue-grey. ⚙︎ › Look › Brushed or Gritty brings the grit back.
  • Samples your samplers play (Sampler, Quick Sampler, Drum Machine Designer pads) are shared when a track you hear plays them, and leftover copies nothing plays aren't.
  • Rooms are now private end to end: everything after the handshake is encrypted, and the room code is much harder to guess from what the relay sees. Everyone in a room needs this version: Combiner says so when someone is still on an older one.
  • Background renders start Off. Turn them on in ⚙︎ › Background renders, or press Render All.
  • Files over 250 MB don't go over the internet (on your own network they do). ⚙︎ › Largest file changes the limit.
  • Sturdier: a bad file list from someone can't crash or blank your room, and a Combiner that crashes at launch can start in a safe mode and recover.
